# laravelforge_server (Data Source)

Fetches a single Laravel Forge server by ID within an organization.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the server.
- `organization` (String) Slug of the Forge organization that owns the server.

### Read-Only

- `cloud_provider` (String) Underlying server provider (Forge API `provider`; renamed because `provider` is reserved in HCL).
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `ip_address` (String) Public IP address.
- `is_ready` (Boolean) Whether the server has finished provisioning.
- `name` (String) Server name.
- `php_version` (String) Installed PHP version.
- `private_ip_address` (String) Private IP address.
- `region` (String) Region the server runs in.
- `size` (String) Server size / plan.
- `slug` (String) Server slug.
- `type` (String) Server type (e.g. `app`, `web`, `database`).
